jobs.name: syndicate-legacy-a
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production illustrated-science-fiction game-art atlas for Frontlines. Square 2048x2048 artwork with EXACTLY FOUR equal square full-bleed paintings in a precise 2-by-2 grid, no gutters, no margins, no frames, no captions, no text or numbers. Each painting stays inside its quadrant; do not blend scenes across the two midlines. Polished detailed painted graphic-novel military concept art, matching worn armor and cinematic lighting of a serious military strategy game. NOT a photograph, NOT flat vector art, NOT anime. Coherent equipment, convincing anatomy, controlled lighting, readable silhouettes. Center each primary face/helmet AND distinctive equipment/action in the central 70 percent of its tile; readable at card thumbnail size. Four intentionally different compositions, camera angles and tactical subjects. No excessive bloom, logos, badges or UI.
THE SYNDICATE: professional black/graphite equipment, amber-gold optics, clean tactical lines, drones, advanced targeting and communications, controlled yellow light in a modern damaged city.
TOP LEFT: A portable armored communications relay with clean antenna arrays, gold indicator strips and secured power modules, stationed behind a coordinated squad. The deployable hardware is central and clearly readable.
TOP RIGHT: A reconnaissance operator receives fresh information from two compact camera drones while comparing physical sensor data on a small tactical slate. Clean professional equipment and an active intelligence-gathering scene; no readable UI text.
BOTTOM LEFT: A professional electronic-warfare specialist interrupts an enemy supply drone’s power-control connection. A grounded crate carrier stops mid-delivery while its status lamps fail; show the disrupted logistics as the action.
BOTTOM RIGHT: A specialist uses a compact countermeasure transmitter as a hostile tactical signal dissolves before reaching an allied unit. Physical equipment, tight restrained golden interference arcs and a protected ally communicate a timely override.
